reviews.value: I’m a regular Whole Foods customer and I’ve honestly been surprised by some of the customer service and overall store experience lately. Over the past couple of weeks, I’ve had a few interactions that felt dismissive and unhelpful. At the deli counter, there’s a young woman working there who comes across as consistently uninterested and short with customers. It’s confusing to me how this level of service is being allowed to continue, especially at a store that usually prides itself on friendliness and professionalism.

review4: Many shoppers still find friendly cashiers, a pleasant atmosphere and a tempting bakery and health section. Several separate reviews echo this point.
